title: Funky Numbers
statementMd:
As you very well know, this year's funkiest numbers are so called triangular numbers (that is, integers that are representable as ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/48cf4d33526da5209922c993ddf2320013993147.png), where $*k*$ is some positive integer), and the coolest numbers are those that are representable as a sum of two triangular numbers.

A well-known hipster Andrew adores everything funky and cool but unfortunately, he isn't good at maths. Given number $*n*$, help him define whether this number can be represented by a sum of two triangular numbers (not necessarily different)!

## Input

The first input line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9})$.

## Output

Print "YES" (without the quotes), if $*n*$ can be represented as a sum of two triangular numbers, otherwise print "NO" (without the quotes).

## Note

In the first sample number ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/92095692c6ea93e9e3b837a0408ba7543549d5b2.png).

In the second sample number $512$ can not be represented as a sum of two triangular numbers.
statementZhMd:
众所周知，今年最有趣的数字是所谓的三角形数（即可以表示为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/48cf4d33526da5209922c993ddf2320013993147.png) 的整数，其中 $*k*$ 是某个正整数），而最酷的数字则是两个三角形数之和。

知名的潮人 Andrew 喜爱一切有趣且酷的事物，但遗憾的是，他不擅长数学。给定一个数 $*n*$，请帮助他判断这个数是否可以表示为两个三角形数之和（这两个三角形数可以相同）。

## 输入

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$）。

## 输出

如果 $*n*$ 可以表示为两个三角形数之和，输出 "YES"（不含引号）；否则输出 "NO"（不含引号）。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，数字 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/92095692c6ea93e9e3b837a0408ba7543549d5b2.png)。

在第二个样例中，数字 $512$ 无法表示为两个三角形数之和。
